topic: Word of mouth is real, but it is not a system, and it goes quiet exactly when you need it.

slides.subtitle: (it is luck with good manners)
slides.scene: The ScaileAI field technician standing alone in the middle of an empty garage with the roller door open on a grey afternoon, no vehicle on the driveway beyond, hands at their sides. All vehicles and buildings in shot have COMPLETELY BLANK panels and surfaces with absolutely no writing, no company name, no logo, no lettering, no phone number and no graphics of any kind. No signage anywhere in the scene. There is NO text, no words and no labels anywhere in the image.

caption:
Most contractors I talk to built the business on referrals, and they are right to be proud of it. It means the work is good.

The trouble is what happens in a slow month.

Referrals arrive when they arrive. You cannot ask them to arrive faster, you cannot turn them up in February, and the month they go quiet is usually the month you needed them most. That is not a strategy, that is weather.

And it hides things. When the phone rings on its own you never find out how many people looked you up, could not reach you, and moved on. The referrals cover the leak.

None of this means chasing strangers. The most reliable work is still the people who already know you, contacted on purpose rather than by chance.

If you want to see what that looks like on your own numbers, book a twenty minute walkthrough at scaileai.com.
